name: Vandenberg SFB
description: Vandenberg SFB is the West Coast launch site for national security space missions and home of Space Launch Delta 30. It supports polar orbit launches and missile testing.

currentNotifications.title: REAL ID Required for Base Access
currentNotifications.body: A REAL ID-compliant driver's license or equivalent is required for base access per DHS mandate.

gates.name: Santa Maria Gate
gates.notes: Primary 24/7 access point. VCC located outside this gate.
gates.address: Santa Maria Gate, Vandenberg SFB, CA 93437

gates.name: Lompoc Gate
gates.notes: Commercial vehicle gate with limited public hours.

gates.name: Visitor Control Center
gates.hours: Mon-Fri 0600-1800; closed Sat-Sun and federal holidays
gates.notes: Day passes and visitor registration. REAL ID required. Phone: 805-606-7663. Located outside Santa Maria Gate.

resources.name: Breakers Dining Facility
resources.description: Primary DFAC supporting space launch operations with full meal service, N’Rich Grill, Global Grill, deli, pizza, salad bar, and wireless access.
resources.address: Bldg 13330, Oregon Ave, Vandenberg SFB, CA 93437

resources.name: Vandenberg Main Exchange (BX)
resources.description: Full-service Exchange with retail, services, and food court options.

resources.name: CoastHills Federal Credit Union
resources.description: Full-service credit union branch on base with ATM.

resources.name: Duane G. Wolfe Fitness Center
resources.description: Main fitness facility with cardio, weights, group exercise, and sports amenities. 24/7 access available at Fitness Annex (Bldg 9005) after registration.
resources.address: Bldg 10130, Washington Ave, Vandenberg SFB, CA 93437

resources.name: Unaccompanied Housing / Dorm Management
resources.description: Dormitory management and assignments supporting space launch personnel.
resources.address: 347 South Dakota Ave, Vandenberg SFB, CA 93437

resources.name: Pacific Coast Inn (AF Lodging)
resources.description: Official temporary lodging and TLF. 24-hour front desk for arrivals.

resources.name: Military & Family Readiness Center (M&FRC)
resources.description: Relocation assistance, financial counseling, employment support, family programs, Newcomers’ Orientation, and Total Force readiness. Mandatory for active duty.
resources.address: Bldg 10122, 706 Washington Ave, Vandenberg SFB, CA 93437

resources.name: 30th Force Support Squadron (FSS)
resources.description: Full MWR, dining, fitness, lodging, recreation, and family support programs supporting space launch operations.
resources.hours: See directory for individual facility hours

resources.name: Outdoor Recreation
resources.description: Equipment rental and recreational programs supporting the Central Coast community.

resources.name: Vandenberg Golf Course
resources.description: 18-hole golf course with pro shop and dining.

resources.name: 30th Medical Group
resources.description: Primary care, specialty clinics, and TRICARE services supporting space launch operations.

sections.title: Required Documents
sections.body: PCS orders, CAC, medical/dental records, marriage and birth certificates if applicable, and travel receipts for finance settlement.

sections.title: Housing
sections.body: Contact Pacific Coast Inn for initial arrival. Dormitory Management (805-605-2048) for unaccompanied housing. Family housing through Balfour Beatty Communities.

sections.title: Quick Resources
sections.body: 30 FSS, M&FRC, and official Vandenberg sites for in-processing and space launch support.
